procedure: Generate a local archive with npm pack --ignore-scripts --json and an isolated offline npm cache.
Check every archive member stays under package/ before extracting into an owned temporary directory.
Start a new Node process from outside the source checkout with NODE_PATH, NODE_OPTIONS and NODE_V8_COVERAGE removed.
Install an fs.readFileSync guard before importing the extracted startup composition; resolve physical paths and refuse reads outside the extracted package.
Load the fixed catalog, model, SPEC, skills and direct implementation inputs; compare model/catalog identity with the source assets.
boundary: The guard covers the synchronous asset reads used by this loader and binding digest, not arbitrary process filesystem access or OS isolation.
archive_retention: Temporary archive and extracted project removed after the probe.
